articles.title: Letter: the Millrace Youth Center Did a Good Job This Summer
body: To the editor: I have lived on Birch Avenue for 33 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Youth Center has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the October meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the street tree planting in the budget. Many of us on Birch Avenue use it every week.
